text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Doto! Please, accept<n>this gift from
me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-you remembered my birthday... and<n>even got me
a p-present?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! It's only natural that I would<n>remember!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of your present, behold! An<n>A2-size clear
poster featuring none<n>other than yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much. I'll take good<n>care—no, I'll
treasure it forever!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, but... if I'm the one keeping it<n>safe, it might get
blemished, ripped, or<n>burned...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that were to happen to your<n>present... I-I don't
know what I would<n>do!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-on second thought, y-you can have<n>it back!
